exposure: social and demographic characteristics (education, paid employment)
outcome: level of adherence to pelvic floor exercise
cohort: The study included 360 females who were being treated for urinary incontinence after C-section.
finding: Treatment adherence to pelvic floor exercises was primarily associated with therapy-related, healthcare team, system-related, condition-related, patient-related, and certain social and demographic factors, with most participants showing moderate adherence.
mod_finding: The study cohort specifically focused on females who had experienced a C-section as their mode of birth, investigating factors affecting their adherence to pelvic floor exercises postpartum.
cross-section timing: after C-section (postpartum period for UI treatment)
